title: Community relations documentation 1970 - 47323287
doc_notes: This document is a collection of administrative correspondence, community relations records, and internal memoranda from the USAF 21st Air Division (ADC) at Hancock Field, Syracuse, NY, covering the year 1970.

incidents.summary: Enrico Grimaldi observed multiple unidentified objects moving in a uniform pattern across the night sky.
incidents.quote: The objects looked like faint stars, they moved in a straight line from north to south.
